title: vtc-server: per-account active livestream cap (overQuota)
description: From audit JMAP-t8ej.3 (row 7), spec 8cd777e: server SHOULD cap starting/live livestreams per account and return SetError overQuota above the cap. Nothing today (media.rs has no overQuota). Add a deployment cap (backend method with a None=unlimited default, or capability config); create_livestream counts the account's starting/live livestreams and returns overQuota at the cap. Tests at cap and cap+1. Needs the vtc-types bead first.
